## The default view's day ranking — `data/season/2026.activity.json`

`2026.activity.json` is the ranking the default view opens by: working hulls per
captured day of the 2026 season, measured by the page's own allocator over each
day's published record. It is generated by `tools/gen_activity.py` from the
committed season files named in its sidecar — no network, no new fact of any real
fire — and `make activitycheck` regenerates it byte for byte. Each day is loaded
the way a visitor loads it (`?day=DATE&seed=7`, still air, no satellite heat), the page's
own allocator runs over that day's published record, and the count is the hulls
left with a feasible plan; ties go to the newest date. The underlying season files
remain under OGL–British Columbia in their own records; this measurement of the
simulated fleet is project-generated under Apache-2.0. No agency endorses this
project; nothing here has official status.
